message.content: According to the conversations, WolfgangSchulz remembers several places in Europe as stunning. Specifically, he mentions the fjords in Norway as breathtaking, and the lavender fields in Provence as having a "sea of purple" vibe. Additionally, he describes Prague's streets as magical, particularly at night, and highlights the charm of the old town square. These locations stand out as memorable and visually captivating in WolfgangSchulz's recollection of his travels across Europe.
